content.title: Fixed Witness Frame | The Outside World Descends by States
content.summary: Lock a moving cabin, its window, and the same adult witnesses as reality anchors. Change only the outside world through ordered, legible states; let each landscape lead and each reaction lag by one beat, while exterior light continues to affect the unchanged interior.

quick_start.input_format: fixed camera, window frame, and at least two adult witnesses inside one carrier + constant travel direction while the exterior descends through at least four ordered states + each state becomes visible before reactions escalate + exterior light affects the same cabin + final new world and unchanged witnesses hold together
quick_start.recommended_input: A brass deep-sea pod, round porthole, three blue lamps, and two adult researchers remain fixed. Clear water gives way to layered luminous life and then a dry abyss; green-blue light returns across the same brass frame and faces as the pod keeps moving.
required_anchors: Lock one camera inside a moving carrier with stable window, interior and at least two adult witness anchors.
Transform only the exterior through at least four ordered world states while carrier direction remains constant.
Couple exterior escalation to changing light spill across the unchanged interior.
End with a qualitatively new terminal world and the same witnesses still inside the carrier.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Lock a moving cabin, its window, and the same adult witnesses as reality anchors. Change only the outside world through ordered, legible states; let each landscape lead and each reaction lag by one beat, while exterior light continues to affect the unchanged interior.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock the camera inside one original moving carrier with a persistent window frame, interior geometry and at least two clearly adult witness identities. Keep the carrier's movement direction and interior continuity stable while the exterior passes through at least four increasingly impossible world states. Let each state become visually legible through the window before witness performance changes, then escalate reactions from indifference to attention, bracing and silent awe without turning the adults into narrators. Use environmental light spill to bind exterior changes back onto the same interior. End after one final threshold reveals a qualitatively different terminal world while the unchanged carrier and witnesses remain visible. The reusable mechanism is fixed witness frame, stable carrier interior, staged exterior state descent, reaction lag, light-spill coupling and terminal-world arrival—not the source train, passengers, faces, phone look, city, tunnels, lava, hell imagery, exact route, camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one camera inside a moving carrier with stable window, interior and at least two adult witness anchors.
invariants.purpose: Creates a trusted continuous reality frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Exterior-only cuts cannot prove one witnessed journey.

invariants.rule: Transform only the exterior through at least four ordered world states while carrier direction remains constant.
invariants.purpose: Turns the window into a controlled state machine.
invariants.ablation_failure: Interior resets or random directions break continuity.

invariants.rule: Show each exterior state clearly before witness reactions increase.
invariants.purpose: Lets evidence cause performance rather than the reverse.
invariants.ablation_failure: Premature reactions feel scripted and ungrounded.

invariants.rule: Couple exterior escalation to changing light spill across the unchanged interior.
invariants.purpose: Physically binds both layers into one event.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated color grading makes the window look composited.

invariants.rule: End with a qualitatively new terminal world and the same witnesses still inside the carrier.
invariants.purpose: Confirms irreversible travel rather than a visual loop.
invariants.ablation_failure: Removing the carrier at the end loses the witness contract.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source commuter passengers, faces, clothing, phone gestures and exact reactions
the source maglev carriage, handles, window and interior geometry
the source city, tunnel, rock, lava, fire, monumental structures and cold terminal realm
the source smartphone camera sway, route order, compositions, light sequence and 26-second timing
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording and truncated prompt
